name: pike-marketfront
summary: Plan written to plan.md. MarketFront is four 7-high tiers facing west and stepping up the bluff. Each tier's deck is a railed terrace for the one above: decks at y 6, 13, 20, 28, the top one a plaza flush with Pike Place, with planters and a bronze pig. Above sit white housing with timber fins and the older white-brick market building. Plot 1 is the Overlook landing: zigzag 9-wide stairs between terraces at y 2, 9, 16, 23, landscaped banks, and a concrete-and-glass lift tower. Each tier's west face repeats glass, timber and grey stone, the concept's look of glowing stacked shopfronts at dusk. MarketFront is four west-facing tiers (grey stone base, spruce-and-glass bands) stepping up the bluff to a flush Pike Place plaza with the bronze pig, planters and benches. Above the tiers stand white housing with balconies, the quartz-brick old market and the lift towers. The hillclimb plot is zigzag stair terraces with planted banks and a HILLCLIMB glass tower, lit at dusk by froglight glow, lanterns and candles. (7 of 7 parts finished)
